title: Scoria's Angel/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Dialogue from the Scoria's Angel mission in Uranus Proxima.
- Vena: "What Orion wants, he gets. And Orion wants me to practice. If Ryoku winds up skewered on my blades, it's an accident. Simply tragic."

- Vena: "Old Hunhow needs a little excitement, and what's more exciting than blood sport? Today we're going to find a way onto Ryoku's capital ship. Then, we're going to bleed him until he screams and screams. And screams."
- Vena: "I'm sick of Pontis Tower. I crave battle. Ryoku, you better be ready. We're coming."
- Vena: "Ryoku desires a challenge to please old man Hunhow. I desire blood. His. We will slice up his operation and then we will cut down the Yaiba himself."
- Vena: "These Security Nodes act as Ryoku's eyes. Claw them out."
- Vena: "Take out those security nodes. Ryoku already knows we're coming. Don't let him see from where."
- Vena: "Emergency! Specters! In Ryoku's image. Consider this a practice run."
- Vena: "What's this? Another Scoria trick? Deal with them."
- Vena: "Corpus intruders on deck. Cut them down."
- Vena: "Corpus elites incoming. They'll bleed just the same."
- Vena: "We've been breached. Corpus units, the expensive ones."
- Vena: "Intruders! Wait... is that... a Sister of Parvos? Not on my ship."
- Vena: "Disease bags incoming. Lance these wretched boils."
- Vena: "Ramsleds! That sneaky bastard is working with Grineer. Slice them up."
- Vena: "Enemies on board. Scrub the decks."
- Jarka: "Jarka was captured. Packed into ramsled and sent to die. Jarka is most happy to find Tenno."
- Jarka: "Tenno? Jarka was stuck in ramsled too long, thinking about Tenno friend. Then, surprise, Jarka crashes into friend."
- Vena: "Nothing left of the intruders but a disgusting mess. Wonderful."
- Vena: "Intruders cut down. Oh, how I love a good mess."
- Vena: "Is that all? I was just getting started."
- Vena: "All clear. Crew, back to your stations!"
- Vena: "Get on those turrets, crew! Slice them out of the sky."
- Vena: "Incoming. We're about to be swarmed!"
- Vena: "Supply transports marked. Blast their cargo but leave the ships intact."
- Vena: "Supply Transports. Destroy their cargo and send them running."
- Vena: "First cargo destroyed. Pilot panic will be setting in soon."
- Vena: "Look at that. Right back to home. Predictable fools. Mark a course to that waypoint."
- Vena: "As predicted, they've fled right to a massive cloaking signature. Hit it with the forward artillery, let's see what's on the other side."
- Vena: "Look, a cloaked vessel. Give it a love tap with the forward artillery, tell it to come out and play."
- Vena: "Well, well. Ryoku's comet shredder. This is how he's supplying his units. Tenno, prepare for boarding."
- Vena: "Now it's our turn to do some breaching. Shall we?"
- Vena: "Attackers! Keep them off my back."
- Vena: "Tenno, be kind and put these worthless mercs out of their misery before I do."
- Vena: "No fair. I get stuck with the desk job; you get to kill them all."
- Vena: "Tell those bloodbags to shut up! I'm trying to concentrate."
- Vena: "Keep fighting. I've just found something very interesting."
- Vena: "Security disabled. Get those gates open."
- Vena: "It's our house now. Unlock every door they have."
- Vena: "Oh Ryoku, what was yours is now ours."
- Vena: "We're in full control. You know, I've always wanted a comet shredder."
- Vena: "What do we have here? Ship's Captain? Finally, a challenge."
- Vena: "Here comes the head of the ship. Decapitate him."
- Vena: "A good captain always goes down with his ship. What a good captain he was."
- Vena: "Was it good for you captain?"
- Vena: "You! Grab me as many cryo canisters as you can find. Meanwhile, I've got a little project of my own."
- Vena: "You! Be a dear and get those cryo cans for me. I've got my hands full."
- Vena: "Blood infused ice. Hard enough to penetrate the hull of Scoria's Angel."
- Vena: "Look! Everything we need to make those ramsleds pierce a capital ship."
- Vena: "Pucker up, Ryoku, here we come."
- Vena: "Locked! Blow the mag coils to get that gate open."
- Vena: "Gate's held shut with mag coils. Find them, and scrap them."
- Ryoku: "Vena. I thought you'd never come."
Ryoku: "Vena, my will is unbreakable. My honor cannot be stained."
- Vena: "When I am done with you, there will be nothing left but a stain."
Ryoku: "Welcome, Wytch. How should we do it this time?"
Ryoku: "Oh great, Hunhow, I dedicate my coming victory to you."
- Vena: "Ryoku, I never figured you for an ass-kisser. But while we're at it, you can kiss mine too."
Vena: "Here we go again Yaiba...Ever wonder if things between us could have been different?"
- Ryoku: "Now, what would be the fun in that? Wytch."
Vena: "Oh Ryoku, I never grow tired of bleeding you dry."
- Ryoku: "You will not get that satisfaction today. Not even with these wayward Tenno at your side."
Ryoku: "Vena. A simple provocation brings you right to my killing floor. A lesson for these Tenno; The vain are easily manipulated."
- Vena: "Oh Ryoku, would it seem more noble to you if I draped my ego in notions of honor and duty? Like you do?"
Vena: "Come now Ryoku. Let's give old grandpa a grand finale."
- Ryoku: "You fight only for the thrill. It blinds you. Makes you weak."
Ryoku: "Perhaps now Sirius and I can teach you and Orion some much needed manners."
- Vena: "I do have manners! Which is why, after I slit your throat and leave you gurgling in your own blood, I won't tell my Orion you said that."
Ryoku: "Vena, you lack both honor and discipline. You sully The Stalker's legacy."
- Vena: "Sully his legacy? Like me, he's an animal driven by vengeance and bloodlust. We both know it. Why won't you admit it?"
Ryoku: "I will not bleed for you, not today."
- Vena: "Oh Ryoku, you should know by now, I'm not giving you a choice."
Ryoku: "Tenno, you fight well. Vena is unworthy of such noble fury."
- Vena: "If I was unworthy, you wouldn't be here, Ryoku. Just admit it. You need me."
Vena: "You fight for honor and duty. I fight for pleasure, and I am going to enjoy every last moment of your end."
- Ryoku: "I have lived to see Sirius reunited with brother and father. Unencumbered by the burden of duty, I fight with abandon. You have been warned, Wytch."
Vena: "Any last words before we make this hurt?"
- Ryoku: "Last words? I have not even started."
Vena: "If it wasn't for the truce, I would have put you down for good, Ryoku. We both know it."
- Ryoku: "You are going to lose today. You were only ever going to lose. The truce is your salvation. Submit to it."
Ryoku: "You think you've won, but my Kunai will find your jugular before the day is done."
- Vena: "Your kunai will make an excellent gift for my Orion. You won't need them much longer."
- Ryoku: "Move like smoke. Strike like lightning. Vanish like morning mist."
- Ryoku: "Stillness before the strike. Silence after."
- Ryoku: "Death should arrive like a whisper, not a shout."
- Ryoku: "A calm mind cuts deeper than a sharp edge."
- Ryoku: "The patient hand guides the swiftest blades."
- Ryoku: "Strike once. Strike true. Strike fatally."
- Ryoku: "Fear is the heaviest weapon you can carry into battle."
- Ryoku: "Technique without thought is chaos. Thought without technique is death."
- Ryoku: "The loudest warrior dies first. Remember this."
- Ryoku: "Your death is already written. I am merely the ink."
- Ryoku: "Watch closely. You will not get a second chance."
- Ryoku: "I am the last lesson you will ever receive."
- Ryoku: "I offer you a quick death."
- Ryoku: "I have killed better foes in worse conditions."
- Ryoku: "Your heartbeat quickens. Soon, it ends."
- Ryoku: "I am the answer to the question you should not have asked."
- Ryoku: "The stillness before your death—savor it."
- Ryoku: "Come, greet your death if you so wish!"
- Vena: "Ryoku's crew will patch him up, but he will always know, Vena defeated him before the great and terrible Hunhow."
- Vena: "You did fight with honor, didn't you? Heal up, big boy."
- Vena: "You better purge those wounds quickly, Ryoku. I want to go again tomorrow."
- Vena: "Did you hear that, Orion? Did you hear how he squealed? We can make that happen again, and again, and again."
